segments.text:
V. 24.
They parted my Garments among them—No Circumſtance of David's Life bore any Reſemblance to this, or to ſeveral other Paſſaves in the 22d Pſalm. So that in this Scripture, as in ſome others, the Prophet ſeems to have been thrown into a preternatural Extaſy, wherein perſonating the M•ſſiah, he ſpoke barely what the Spirit dictated, without any regard to Himſelf.
